messages.subject: Senior International Mining Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear TM Partners Team,

I am reaching out because TM Partners' exclusive focus on global mining leadership makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and country-facing stakeholder leadership within a major gold-mining operation.

I am open to Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates internationally, particularly across Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, ESG/Sustainability, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, while I remain globally mobile.

My current executive CV is attached. I would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming mining and resources mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
